decode_requirements: Capture every actual decode ABI and graph bucket, including tail/batch variants. Decode GPU symbols do not establish missing CPU arguments.
intake_policy: Retain every actual dense record in both families, including BF16/FP32 and distinct equal-shape records; reject unsupported layouts/controls visibly instead of dropping them. No hardcoded M8192 ceiling; sampled M16384 is required evidence.
required_metadata: complete A/B/output dtype, shape, stride, storage_offset, storage_nbytes, alias and physical tensor attributes
all optional bias/otype/scale_a/scale_b/scale_c values, distinguishing absent from tensor
full selected get_GEMM_A16W16_config result, libtype, solidx and solMap callable identity
actual eager/graph origin, stage, active_requests, active_tokens, physical graph bucket and replay linkage
complete notified structural inventory and counts across all8 ranks; real representative bytes for each distinct record
finalized64-request workload and all8 rank stop receipts with byte hashes
sample_limits: One captured operand representative is not full tensor-value history or a distribution-extrema guarantee.

sampled_aten_evidence.scope: These sampled ATen calls can be children of sampled native wrappers. Do not sum wrapper and ATen counts. New owner hook must suppress nested duplicates and retain independent direct calls.
